hints.title: Reverse Search Strategy
hints.text: Working forwards branches exponentially, but working backwards from destination to source is deterministic.

hints.title: Modulo Reduction
hints.text: Instead of subtracting the smaller coordinate one step at a time, use modulo arithmetic to subtract multiple copies in a single operation.

hints.title: Target Alignment Condition
hints.text: When one coordinate matches the source, verify if the remaining difference between the other coordinate and its source target is evenly divisible by the fixed coordinate.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Euclidean algorithm style modulo reduction backwards from target to source.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward recursion or single subtraction backwards times out when coordinates are up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) with iterative modulo reductions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle boundary alignment with modulo subtraction once one coordinate matches source.
